access_notes: The official annual-reports page and the official PDF paths return HTTP 403 to ordinary curl (Cloudflare challenge). The NSW Parliament file service is reachable (HTTP 200) and served the FY2024-25 artifact byte-identically. Historical years were read from Wayback raw captures (HTTP 200); the archived bytes are pinned in SHA256SUMS. The FY2017-18 capture at 20190923004735 is truncated at 1,048,576 bytes (no %%EOF) and was rejected in favour of the full 20200126152225 capture.

premise.finding: WaterNSW publishes full annual reports containing audited general-purpose financial statements with printed statement faces and printed $'000 totals for FY2014-15 and FY2016-17 through FY2024-25 (9 consecutive full years plus the formation-year report). The premise is true. The one gap is FY2015-16: published, but no retrievable own-year byte copy was found (official 403, data.nsw resource 404, Archive-It session challenge, no Wayback capture of the official PDF). FY2015-16 is deferred, not invented; its restated comparative appears in the FY2016-17 report and is not used as an own-year document.

reconciliation_basis: Printed $'000. Face income-statement components are summed to the printed total revenue/expenses, then the printed operating-profit, disposal/other, revaluation, profit-before-tax and net-result bridges are re-added. No scaling, no derivation, no cross-entity or cross-year sum.

overlap_rules: Entity only: never add WaterNSW rows to government program spending, the PNFC benchmark, Sydney Water, Hunter Water, or each other; no cross-entity and no cross-year totals.
Face statement is the control total; note components are soc_component_of their printed subtotal and are never added to a face total.
Consolidated vs parent: choose consolidated from FY2018-19; parent-only before; never add the two boundaries.

Own-year only: do not ingest a later report's restated comparative as the earlier year (e.g. FY2019-20's 2019 comparative is 416,874 revenue / 63,614 operating profit, not FY2018-19's 455,142 / 101,882).
Summary tables (narrative 'financial outcomes'/'summary financial performance') are not the audited statement and are not used for totals.
Revaluation gains/losses are inside revenue/expenses in FY2014-15-FY2018-19 and below operating profit from FY2019-20; do not move them between years or treat them as cash spend.
Grants are included in total revenue; do not add the grant lines again; flag potential double count.
FY2014-15 State Water 2014 column is a predecessor comparative; never add it to WaterNSW 2015.
No profit/margin derivation; store the printed net result with its sign.
builder_sequence: Year-parameterise discovery for FY2016-17..FY2024-25 using the archived URLs/timestamps, keeping the official URL as provenance and the Wayback/Parliament artifact as retrieved_from. Do not hard-code one page/PDF URL.
Layout family A: FY2019-20..FY2024-25 (4-column consolidated/parent; Total revenue/Total expenses; revaluation below operating profit). Build first (6 years).
Layout family B: FY2018-19 (3-column, first consolidated, Parent 2018 only, revaluation inside revenue). Build second.
Layout family C: FY2016-17 and FY2017-18 (2-column parent-only, unlabelled totals, revaluation inside revenue). Build third.
Defer FY2014-15 (formation/partial period, State Water predecessor comparative, revaluation expense) until a dedicated transition-year spec is scoped.
Defer FY2015-16 (no retrievable own-year bytes) and FY2025-26 (not published as at 2026-11-18).
